title: Open a file or folder
summary: Open documents, single images, or entire folders as multi-page collections.

sections.heading: Opening Files
sections.text: You can open individual PDF documents or image files through the toolbar or File menu.

sections.heading: Opening Folders
sections.text: Opening a folder loads all supported images in that directory as a multi-page document.

steps: Click the Open button on the top toolbar, or select File > Open...
Choose a PDF file or an image, then click Open.
To view multiple images together, select File > Open Folder...
note: You can also reopen recent files by selecting File > Open Recent.
